input.explanation: The fault is entirely in this repo. `categorise` passed capitalised words to v2, a model that expects words already lowercased by its training pipeline and does no case folding itself. With the title now lowercased in `categorise`, v2 matches what it was trained on as soon as this deploys with `categoriser.model: v2`. Nothing outside this repo has to change. The model files ship in the image and their vocabularies are already lowercase.
